dialogues.jp: 桜並木まで出て軽く伸びをした。
dialogues.en: I walked to the road with cherry trees and stretched.
dialogues.text: I walked to the road with cherry trees and stretched.

dialogues.jp:
日曜日の入学式ということで、時間も朝早くは
ないおかげで中途半端なまったりな空気が漂っ
ている。
dialogues.en:
It's Sunday and not too early in the morning, so the time
seems to go by slower than usual.
dialogues.text:
It's Sunday and not too early in the morning, so the time
seems to go by slower than usual.

dialogues.jp:
在校生は基本的に出席しないのか、先に来てい
るのか知らないが、まばらに登校している奴は
顔見知りが多い。
dialogues.en:
Maybe only the freshmen are supposed to come for the
entrance ceremony. I recognized a lot of faces of people
that are walking toward school.
dialogues.text:
Maybe only the freshmen are supposed to come for the
entrance ceremony. I recognized a lot of faces of people
that are walking toward school.

dialogues.jp: 「しかし、男の制服は変わらないんだな」
dialogues.en: "The boys' uniform is still the same."
dialogues.text: "The boys' uniform is still the same."

dialogues.jp: 面倒じゃなくていいけど。
dialogues.en: It's better than having to buy a new set of uniforms.
dialogues.text: It's better than having to buy a new set of uniforms.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くん」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉先輩っ！」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sempai!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sempai!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「おはよう、ことり」
dialogues.en: "Good morning, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Good morning, Kotori."

dialogues.jp:
振り返った先で、ブレザー姿になったことりが
微笑んでいた。
dialogues.en:
I turned around and found Kotori wearing a new uniform
smiling at me.
dialogues.text:
I turned around and found Kotori wearing a new uniform
smiling at me.

dialogues.jp:
「似合うね制服。まぁ、ことりならどんな服を
　着ても可愛いと思うけど」
dialogues.en:
"You look good in that uniform. I'm sure you'd look good in
any clothes."
dialogues.text:
"You look good in that uniform. I'm sure you'd look good in
any clothes."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そんなことないですよ」
dialogues.en: "Not at all."
dialogues.text: "Not at all."

dialogues.jp: そんな健気なことりに似合いそうな服か。
dialogues.en: What kind of clothes would Kotori look good in?
dialogues.text: What kind of clothes would Kotori look good in?

dialogues.jp: 「メイド服かな……」
dialogues.en: "How about a French maid costume?"
dialogues.text: "How about a French maid costume?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あのぉ〜先輩。遠い世界に行くのはいいんで
　すけど、美春は無視ですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Before you wander off into another world, how about me?
Aren't you ignoring me?"
dialogues.text:
"Before you wander off into another world, how about me?
Aren't you ignoring me?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「お、美春。元気にしてたか」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Miharu. How have you been?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Miharu. How have you been?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あ……はい」
急に美春が肩を落とす。
dialogues.en: Miharu dropped her shoulders suddenly.
dialogues.text: Miharu dropped her shoulders suddenly.

dialogues.jp: 「いや……すまない」
dialogues.en: "Well...... Sorry."
dialogues.text: "Well...... Sorry."

dialogues.jp:
なにげない日常にしようとしたのに、音夢のこ
とが思い出されてしまう。
dialogues.en: I try to be casual, but I kept thinking about Nemu.
dialogues.text: I try to be casual, but I kept thinking about Nemu.

dialogues.jp:
いや、俺は思っていてもいいのだが、やはり美
春やことりをその空気に巻き込むことはない。
dialogues.en:
I guess I can think about whatever I want, but I shouldn't
have Miharu and Kotori involved in it.
dialogues.text:
I guess I can think about whatever I want, but I shouldn't
have Miharu and Kotori involved in it.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あの、朝倉くん――」
dialogues.en: "Ah, Asakura-kun......"
dialogues.text: "Ah, Asakura-kun......"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そういえば、新入生代表の挨拶とかするのっ
　てやっぱりことりか？」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, are you the one who's giving the address at the
ceremony representing the freshmen?"
dialogues.text:
"Oh, are you the one who's giving the address at the
ceremony representing the freshmen?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え、違うよ。私じゃない」
dialogues.en: "No, not me."
dialogues.text: "No, not me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「なんだ。ことりなら、挨拶の文章を短くして
　もらおうと思ったのに」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, I was going to ask you to make it short if you were
going to do it."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, I was going to ask you to make it short if you were
going to do it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「これから宜しくお願いします。では――とか」
dialogues.en:
"Kind of like -- hello everyone, goodbye, or something like
that."
dialogues.text:
"Kind of like -- hello everyone, goodbye, or something like
that."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なにそれ」
dialogues.en: "What's that?"
dialogues.text: "What's that?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「どうせ誰も聞いてないんだから、絶対にいいっ
　て」
dialogues.en: "Nobody listens to it anyways. I think it's a great idea."
dialogues.text: "Nobody listens to it anyways. I think it's a great idea."

dialogues.jp:
我慢をしているのだろうが、音夢よりも分かり
やすく美春がそわそわとしている。
dialogues.en:
I think she's trying to hide it, but Miharu's more obvious
than Nemu, she's acting restlessly.
dialogues.text:
I think she's trying to hide it, but Miharu's more obvious
than Nemu, she's acting restlessly.

dialogues.jp:
ぐぐっ、と首を後ろに逸らして、美春が自分の
身体を抱いている。
dialogues.en: She's tilting her head backward, and holding on to herself.
dialogues.text: She's tilting her head backward, and holding on to herself.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あはは……朝倉君。私も知りたいかな」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, I want to know as well."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, I want to know as well."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「分かった分かった」
dialogues.en: "Okay, okay."
dialogues.text: "Okay, okay."

dialogues.jp: ことりのフォローに俺は肩をすくめる。
dialogues.en: Kotori came in to help Miharu, and I shrugged my shoulders.
dialogues.text: Kotori came in to help Miharu, and I shrugged my shoulders.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あ、ＯＫですか？　音夢先輩の様子はどうな
　んです？　美春はもう心配で心配で」
dialogues.en:
"Oh, so it's okay to ask now? How's Nemu-sempai? I'm so
worried about her."
dialogues.text:
"Oh, so it's okay to ask now? How's Nemu-sempai? I'm so
worried about her."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「昨日なんてあんまりにも心配でバナナも３本
　しか喉を通らず、残った物でもいいから音夢
　先輩へのお土産にしようと思ったんですよ」
dialogues.en:
"I was so worried I could only eat three bananas yesterday,
and I thought about bringing the rest for Nemu-sempai!"
dialogues.text:
"I was so worried I could only eat three bananas yesterday,
and I thought about bringing the rest for Nemu-sempai!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「でも、朝倉先輩との蜜月っぽいと評判の日々
　の中に入るのは思わず｛ためら／躊躇｝ってしまった次第
　で、でも外から覗くくらいはいいかなとか」
dialogues.en:
"But, I heard you and Nemu-sempai are in middle of a
honeymoon and I felt bad to bother you two. And I wondered
if it's okay to look into the house from outside."
dialogues.text:
"But, I heard you and Nemu-sempai are in middle of a
honeymoon and I felt bad to bother you two. And I wondered
if it's okay to look into the house from outside."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「とりあえず今は、美春とは正反対に落ち着い
　てるよ」
dialogues.en: "She's fine now, and settled, unlike you."
dialogues.text: "She's fine now, and settled, unlike you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「そうなんだ」
dialogues.en: "She is?"
dialogues.text: "She is?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「あぅ、とにかく、大丈夫なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "So, she's okay?"
dialogues.text: "So, she's okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「あぁ……今日はこれないけど、ある程度調子
　を見て問題なければ復学できるさ」
dialogues.en:
"She can't come today, but we'll see. She'll be able to come
back if she doesn't have any more problems for a while."
dialogues.text:
"She can't come today, but we'll see. She'll be able to come
back if she doesn't have any more problems for a while."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……そっか」

ほっ、と胸をなでおろしたことりだが、ふと隣
に視線を送る。
dialogues.en: Kotori looked relieved and looked beside her.
dialogues.text: Kotori looked relieved and looked beside her.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「朝倉先輩……じゃあ、音夢先輩は今日、おう
　ちでお留守番してるんですか？」
dialogues.en: "So, Nemu-sempai's staying at home today?"
dialogues.text: "So, Nemu-sempai's staying at home today?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ん……あぁ」

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉先輩……音夢先輩がかわいそうです」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sempai...... I feel bad for Nemu-sempai."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sempai...... I feel bad for Nemu-sempai."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「美春ちゃん……」
dialogues.en: "Miharu-chan......"
dialogues.text: "Miharu-chan......"

dialogues.jp: なんと説明したらいいものか頭をかく。
dialogues.en: I didn't know how to explain.
dialogues.text: I didn't know how to explain.

dialogues.jp:
「あのな美春……色々と事情があるんだが、俺
　が家に残るほうが音夢にも辛いんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Miharu...... we all have our circumstances, but it's harder
for Nemu if I stay home with her."
dialogues.text:
"Miharu...... we all have our circumstances, but it's harder
for Nemu if I stay home with her."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「それは分かります。朝倉先輩の気持ちも分か
　ります」
dialogues.en:
"Yes, I understand that. And I understand your feelings
too."
dialogues.text:
"Yes, I understand that. And I understand your feelings
too."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「でも……でも……」

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「おぃ、美春！？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, Miharu?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Miharu?"

dialogues.jp:
ざわざわ、と周りを通り過ぎていく学生がこち
らの様子を窺っている。
dialogues.en: The students walking by are looking at us.
dialogues.text: The students walking by are looking at us.

dialogues.jp:
これが卒業式ならともかく、入学式で感極まっ
た後輩とは見てくれないだろう。
dialogues.en:
I can make an excuse if this happened on the graduation day,
but no one cries on the first day of school.
dialogues.text:
I can make an excuse if this happened on the graduation day,
but no one cries on the first day of school.

dialogues.jp:
「この光景をはたから見たとして、どう考える
　ことり！？」
dialogues.en:
"What would you make out of this situation if you didn't
know me?"
dialogues.text:
"What would you make out of this situation if you didn't
know me?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くんが泣かしたぁ〜……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun made her cry......"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun made her cry......"

dialogues.jp: ことりが美春の肩を抱きながら二歩下がる。
dialogues.en: Kotori held Miharu's shoulders and stepped backward.
dialogues.text: Kotori held Miharu's shoulders and stepped backward.

dialogues.jp: 「くそっ……どこかに杉並はいないか！？」
dialogues.en: "Shit...... Where's Suginami!"
dialogues.text: "Shit...... Where's Suginami!"

dialogues.jp:
本気で必要な時にいなくて、必要でないときし
かいない奴だ。
dialogues.en:
He's never around when I need him, and he only shows up when
I don't need him.
dialogues.text:
He's never around when I need him, and he only shows up when
I don't need him.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "Sempai......"
dialogues.text: "Sempai......"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「音夢先輩の気持ちを、ほんと〜っに、深く深
　くマリアナ海溝よりも深く考えましたか？」
dialogues.en:
"Did you really think deeply about how Nemu-sempai really
feels? Like deeper than the Mariana trench?"
dialogues.text:
"Did you really think deeply about how Nemu-sempai really
feels? Like deeper than the Mariana trench?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「と、美春ちゃんは思いました」
dialogues.en: "That's what Miharu-chan thought."
dialogues.text: "That's what Miharu-chan thought."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「白河先輩？」
dialogues.en: "Shirakawa-sempai?"
dialogues.text: "Shirakawa-sempai?"

dialogues.jp:
美春の肩に手をおいたまま、ことりは歌うよう
に呟く。
dialogues.en:
Kotori mumbled like she was singing as she held Miharu's
shoulders.
dialogues.text:
Kotori mumbled like she was singing as she held Miharu's
shoulders.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「音夢さんは朝倉君が家にいたら、本当に傷つ
　いたと思う」
dialogues.en:
"I think Nemu-chan would feel bad if Asakura-kun stayed
home."
dialogues.text:
"I think Nemu-chan would feel bad if Asakura-kun stayed
home."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「自分のせいで朝倉くんに迷惑をかけるって、
　すごく悩むと思う」
dialogues.en:
"And she'd stress about making trouble for him because of
her......"
dialogues.text:
"And she'd stress about making trouble for him because of
her......"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、例え傷ついたとしても、好きな人が側
　にいてくれるのはやっぱり嬉しいと思う」
dialogues.en:
"But, even if she's stressed, she would be happy to have
someone she loves by her side."
dialogues.text:
"But, even if she's stressed, she would be happy to have
someone she loves by her side."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ねっ♪」
dialogues.en: "Right?"
dialogues.text: "Right?"

dialogues.jp: ざわっ、と桜が鳴いた。
dialogues.en: The cherry blossoms moved suddenly.
dialogues.text: The cherry blossoms moved suddenly.

dialogues.jp: 桜並木の中でことりが微笑んでいる。

本当に、彼女が学園のアイドルと呼ばれること
が、どんなに正しいかを理解した。
dialogues.en:
Kotori's smiling in the middle of the road with cherry
trees.
dialogues.text:
Kotori's smiling in the middle of the road with cherry
trees.

dialogues.jp: 「俺、帰る」
dialogues.en:
She's called the idol of this academy, and I realized they
were so right about that.
dialogues.text:
She's called the idol of this academy, and I realized they
were so right about that.

dialogues.jp:
音夢を傷つけることになるかも知れない。でも、
それでも、俺は音夢と一緒にいたい。
dialogues.en:
I'm sure Nemu would refuse if I offered to stay with her,
but she would......
dialogues.text:
I'm sure Nemu would refuse if I offered to stay with her,
but she would......

dialogues.jp:
そして、俺がつけた傷なら、一生かけて癒して
いこう。
dialogues.en: Smile and be happy at the end.
dialogues.text: Smile and be happy at the end.

dialogues.jp: それはきっと、音夢だって同じはずだ。
dialogues.en: "I'm going home."
dialogues.text: "I'm going home."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉先輩！」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-sempai!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-sempai!"

dialogues.jp: わんこも驚くほどの歓喜をあげる美春。
dialogues.en: I pointed at her as Miharu raised her voice with joy.
dialogues.text: I pointed at her as Miharu raised her voice with joy.

dialogues.jp: 俺はビシッと指差した。
dialogues.en:
"Don't get me wrong, Miharu! I'm going home because I'm
really tired!"
dialogues.text:
"Don't get me wrong, Miharu! I'm going home because I'm
really tired!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「お疲れさまです！」
dialogues.en: "Are you that tired?"
dialogues.text: "Are you that tired?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「疲れたくないから帰るんだ！」
dialogues.en: "I'm going home, because I don't want to get more tired!"
dialogues.text: "I'm going home, because I don't want to get more tired!"

dialogues.jp:
学園に集まる波に逆らいながら、何度も振り返っ
て美春を追い払うように手を振る。
dialogues.en:
I waved at Miharu like I was trying to get rid of her,
turning around many times, as I walked against the crowd who
are going to school.
dialogues.text:
I waved at Miharu like I was trying to get rid of her,
turning around many times, as I walked against the crowd who
are going to school.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うふふふふ……」
dialogues.en: "Teeheehee......"
dialogues.text: "Teeheehee......"

dialogues.jp:
見たくは無かったのに、ギリギリのところでこ
とりの顔を見てしまった。
dialogues.en:
I didn't want to see it, but I happened to see how Kotori
looked at the last moment.
dialogues.text:
I didn't want to see it, but I happened to see how Kotori
looked at the last moment.

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりの言葉◆
dialogues.en: ◆What Kotori said◆
dialogues.text: ◆What Kotori said◆

dialogues.jp:
久しぶりに制服を着込み、久しぶりに通学路を
歩く。なんだか、いつもの日常に戻ってきてし
まったかのような感覚。
dialogues.en:
I put on the uniform for the first time in a while and
walked the road to school.It felt like I was returning to
the usual everyday life.
dialogues.text:
I put on the uniform for the first time in a while and
walked the road to school.It felt like I was returning to
the usual everyday life.

dialogues.jp:
そんな時、ことりと出会い話をすると、どんな
に笑っていても、音夢ちゃんは寂しいだろうね
――と言われる。
dialogues.en:
Then, I talked with Kotori and she mentioned how sad Nemu
would be alone even if she was smiling.
dialogues.text:
Then, I talked with Kotori and she mentioned how sad Nemu
would be alone even if she was smiling.

dialogues.jp:
その言葉に後押しされるように、俺は学園では
なく家に向かって足を踏み出した。
dialogues.en:
I decided to go back home instead of going to school, as she
helped me understand how Nemu really felt.
dialogues.text:
I decided to go back home instead of going to school, as she
helped me understand how Nemu really felt.
